content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text resolves the Isaiah 7:14 collision by noting chapter-bound verses, a concession about Matthew 1:23, and an almah/bethulah word-count, so it does the verse-by-verse weighing the rule governs rather than chain-against-chain by footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- the sign's chapter bounds (Isaiah 7:16; 8:3-4; 8:8) are real, but C5's own narrowing concedes Matthew 1:23's application stands, and the almah/bethulah word-count cuts both ways (Joel 1:8); answered in [CR2] section G and [CR3] LINK 5.","rule_words":"the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires","room":"none","why":"It decides the Isaiah 7:14 collision by treating the sign's chapter bounds, Matthew 1:23 application, and almah/bethulah word-count as discrete verse/word points, not by weighing chain against chain by footing."}
